exposure: systematic screening for vasa previa by determining placental cord insertion at the 20-week anomaly scan
cohort: 6038 pregnant women between 18+0 and 24+0 gestational weeks
finding: Systematic screening for vasa previa by assessing placental cord insertion at the 20-week anomaly scan allowed for prenatal diagnosis in all cases, resulting in 100% fetal survival and favorable neonatal outcomes.
